commit.message:
[US525036] Fix/update distributed-idol (#80)

* Fixed:
   * A couple of bugs in the ingress templates preventing a deployment.
   * `podSecurityContext`/`containerSecurityContext`/`resources` weren't being applied (later re-fixed as part of idol-library integration).
   * Bug in `dih_prometheus_exporter.py` preventing a successful deployment if `requests.get` for `getStatus` on dih throws.
   * Mistake in `idol-library` that uses `$component.global` instead of `$root.Values.global` (causes nil pointer error if `$component` is not `$root.Values`, as it isn't for `distributed-idol`).
   * Warning in `idol-library` if we attempt to override the `IDOL_COMPONENT_CFG` environment variable.
   * Typos in the README.
 * Used `idol-library` templates in dah `deployment.yaml` and dih/content `statefulset.yaml`, this involved splitting any container yaml out into separate `_container.tpl` files (following naming conventions of other charts).

Signed-off-by: Joe-Wood <155621637+joe-wood-opentext@users.noreply.github.com>
Reviewed-by: Daniel-Lau <36928012+daniel-lau-mf@users.noreply.github.com>

commit.message:
US#493002 Ingress tls support (#60)

Added tls support for ingress. This is specified by a secretName
parameter, which will enable tls if non-empty. There are also crt and key
parameters if the tls secret is not generated beforehand. If secretName
is specified, but crt and key are left empty,  then we assume that the
secret already exists and attempt to use it in the ingress resource. If they
are specified, then we create a new secret using the provided (base64-
encoded) certificate and key.

Most of the changes are in idol-library, for which the updated release
has been added to the release directory. Other charts versions have
been updated as appropriate, but releases have not yet been added.

Idol-find is also now up to date with the latest idol-library.

Implements: https://internal.almoctane.com/ui/entity-navigation?p=161001/2002&entityType=work_item&id=493002

commit.message:
US#456048 Make IDOL Admin work through Ingress (#48)

Updated idol-library to expose aci, service and index ports so that they
can be accessed via idol admin, e.g. for single-content we can now
view the config file and index documents via idol admin. This only
applies to nginx as it doesn't seem possible via haproxy openshift. 

Also updated ingress templating to make it easier to implement new
paths. Added "portmapping" and "paths" variables to _ingress.tpl. The
former is a dictionary of <port name>:<port path> entries, which are
parsed by the template, and the latter is a list of full path specifications
which must be set in the relevant chart's ingress.yaml file (this last bit
is necessary since helm doesn't merge arrays when templating, so the
full paths array must be specified in idol-library.ingress.base).

Updated most charts to use the above functionality. Idol-nifi and
idol-find have not been updated for now as these use
idol-library.labels instead of idol-library.ingress, so updating these
will be a bit more involved. Idol-nifi version has still been updated as
it is using latest versions of idol-library and idol-licenseserver. 

Also removed idol-licenseserver's dependency on idol-library as
usage was minimal.

---------

Co-authored-by: daniel-lau-mf <36928012+daniel-lau-mf@users.noreply.github.com>
Reviewed-by: daniel-lau-mf <36928012+daniel-lau-mf@users.noreply.github.com>
